claims.text: Patient reports taking metoprolol every morning as usual and feeling fine.
A clinician note records heart rate 48 and states: hold metoprolol until the heart rate is reviewed on Thursday.

citations.quote: Heart rate 48. Hold metoprolol until the heart rate is reviewed on Thursday.

claims.text: The record contains a medication conflict for metoprolol: hold versus take.

open_questions: The record does not state when metoprolol was first started or prescribed, or at what dose.
The record does not show whether metoprolol was held or paused before the current hold instruction.
The record contains only one heart rate reading (48 on 2026-08-15); it does not show when bradycardia first appeared.
The record does not show whether the Thursday heart rate review was carried out or its outcome.
The record contains no earlier entries that resolve the hold-versus-take conflict on metoprolol.
The record documents no prior adverse reaction or intolerance to metoprolol or beta-blockers.

citation.quote: Heart rate 48. Hold metoprolol until the heart rate is reviewed on Thursday.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Clinician-documented hold of metoprolol conflicts with the patient's report of continuing metoprolol every morning, and heart rate 48 is recorded.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Clinician to confirm with the patient whether metoprolol is being taken and to resolve the hold-versus-take conflict before the Thursday review.
